title: AI Congressional Mandates, Executive Orders and Actions (NIST)
claims: NIST AI work driven by congressional mandates (Chips and Science Act 2022; National AI Initiative Act 2020) and Presidential EOs
National AI Initiative Act 2020 established NAIAC and the NAIRR Task Force
NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) reflects the 2020 trustworthy-AI EO and the National AI Initiative Act (voluntary framework)
EO 14110 (10/30/2023) was rescinded 1/20/2025; EO 14179 (1/23/2025) and 'Winning the Race: America's AI Action Plan' (7/23/2025) are current drivers
draft_usage: Cited for the NIST AI RMF (voluntary) and US federal AI mandate landscape under Social (US policy).
